content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets with crypto payments means you can monetize your creativity without the limitations of traditional payment gateways. In countries where platforms like Gumroad charge hefty fees—up to 10% on every sale—switching to a service like NOWPayments allows for a fraction of that cost at just 0.5%. This change can significantly impact your bottom line. For instance, if you sell a $97 product and achieve 100 sales per month, you save around $921 compared to traditional platforms. The power lies in ownership and autonomy over your financial operations, making it vital to embrace this approach.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling design assets directly with crypto payments consists of a blend of free tools and services. At its core, you can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your store. Then, integrate backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. For storing orders, Supabase or Google Sheets are effective solutions. Finally, use NOWPayments for processing crypto payments automatically. This architecture removes dependency on external platforms, enabling you to maintain full control and ownership of your digital store.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions facing payment restrictions. Whether you're in Nigeria, Venezuela, or any other country where traditional payment platforms fail, this solution empowers you to operate independently. Creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital assets can benefit greatly from this model. The sovereignty provided by managing your own commerce stack ensures you're not beholden to arbitrary fee structures or account limitations.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, allowing you to retain more of your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components that enable this infrastructure include hosting solutions, backend processing, order management, and payment gateways. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as your storefront, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script execute order logic seamlessly. Supabase or Google Sheets manage your orders effectively, and NOWPayments enables crypto transactions effortlessly. This combination creates a robust and scalable platform for digital sales, where every part works in harmony to deliver a smooth user experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling design assets with crypto payments, first, select your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Following that, choose your order management tool—either Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. By taking these steps, you can quickly build a sovereign digital commerce stack that operates independently of traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
You own everything after deployment—no subscriptions, no dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in building a complete system for selling digital products without reliance on traditional payment platforms, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to create your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
